items.headline: Sam Houston fires football coach Phil Longo amid 1-7 start to season
items.description: Sam Houston fired coach Phil Longo amid a 1-7 start to the season, the school announced Wednesday. He went 3-17 during his two-season tenure leading the program.

items.headline: Missouri State beats Sam Houston 24-3 behind 2 passing TDs by Henry Belin IV
items.description: — Henry Belin IV threw for 184 yards and two touchdowns, with Isaiah Myers and Jmariyae Robinson each making a touchdown catch, and Missouri State beat Sam Houston 24-3 on Tuesday night.
